news.title: Men Are Experiencing More Job Growth Than Women in AI-Exposed Occupations
news.summary_en: Men’s employment grew faster than women’s in occupations most exposed to AI, a gap driven largely by workers without a bachelor’s degree.

news.title: Pace of Trump’s Judicial Appointments Has Slowed in His Second Term
news.summary_en: President Trump has appointed fewer federal judges in this term than at this point in his first, and his pace trails that of most recent presidents.

news.title: Online Communities Rarely Focus on Politics, and Many Say It Should Stay That Way
news.summary_en: Most people in online communities see little to no politics in their go-to space, and 54% say it doesn’t belong there.

news.title: Broad Public Confidence in Elections in the U.S. – but Partisans Differ Over Concerns About Access, Security
news.summary_en: Most voters expect well-run 2026 midterms, but Republicans and Democrats differ on noncitizen voting safeguards and whether eligible citizens can vote if they choose to.
